reason: A provides the more specific, controlled, and falsifiable proposal, with a defined temperature/environment, composition-matched monolithic baseline, residual-stress checks, and microscopy tied to dislocation-mediated creep; its cited bulk-HEA evidence also supports climb-controlled creep more directly than B’s unsupported generalization. Its main weakness is that interfaces can also promote short-circuit diffusion and the cited creep regime is hotter than the proposed ~573 K tests, so the barrier mechanism is plausible but not firmly established.
